goal_residuals.summary: Следующий mapped unit: installed SDK/Workbench, source rename/delete, project export/import isolation, reload и real-model recall.

coverage.row: Acceptance 1: original messages, tool calls/results, images and provenance survive reset/new session/compaction
Acceptance 2: discover and paginate original conversations from another project
Acceptance 3: durable native close, interruption, visible errors and corrupt records
torn-state × close/reload: last acknowledged snapshot intact, interrupted run incomplete
quota-perm-fail × snapshot write: archive error, error run, no false durable receipt
corrupt-input × discovery/read: corrupt record errors, never complete
concurrent-same-key × cross-tab save: distinct IDs/files retain messages
lossy-aggregate × compact/read: originals beyond context/output remain readable
AgentSessionOptions.archive / AgentArchiveOptions: optional shared namespace and project provenance
AgentSessionEvent.archive: receipt after native close, including revision/state/count
archive_read: bounded original JSON pages, no tool replay
